introHtml: Cooling sport towels with a lid keep the towel wet and ready to use, making them ideal for outdoor events, construction sites, and sports tournaments. The lid prevents evaporation and keeps dirt out, so the towel stays clean and effective. Choose screen printing or embroidery for your logo on the lid or towel fabric. These are a practical upgrade over standard cooling towels for anyone working or playing in the heat.
